items: 【6 Display Shelves & 4 Drawers】 This corner bookshelf features 6 open shelves and 4 fabric drawers, offering both visible and hidden storage for your books, decor, and essentials

【Dynamic LED Lighting Ambiance】Elevate your corner book shelf with integrated, USB-powered LED light strips. Easily control vivid color-changing effects (static, fade, flash, music sync) via touch button or smartphone app to set the perfect mood for your bookshelves or bookcase

【Space-Saving Corner Design】 The corner shelves are specifically crafted to fit snugly in room corners, maximizing space while providing generous storage. Its sleek industrial style, combined with a rich rustic wood finish, infuses modern yet rustic charm to any living room, bedroom, or home office
【Convertible Assembly Options】 With two assembly options, this L-shaped bookshelf can be customized to fit various corner spaces, making it well-suited for any room setup in your home

【Easy Assembly & Hassle-Free Support】 With clearly labeled parts and step-by-step instructions, assembling your bookshelf is quick and simple. Our dedicated customer service team is always ready to assist, ensuring a smooth setup and your complete satisfaction with the product
